北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感偏凉风力不小，早晚注意添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels cooler with notable wind, remember to dress warmly in the morning and evening!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感舒适，多云天适宜户外活动，记得防晒！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels comfortable. Cloudy skies are great for outdoors, remember your sun protection!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感凉爽，湿度稍高，出门记得带把伞哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels cool and a bit humid. Remember to bring an umbrella when you go out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州中雨，体感湿热，出门记得带伞，注意防潮！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has moderate rain and feels hot and humid. Bring an umbrella and mind the dampness!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感闷热，多喝水，注意防暑降温哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and muggy. Drink more water and stay cool to prevent heatstroke!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力较大，体感稍凉，出门记得带件薄外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has strong winds and feels a bit cool. Remember to bring a light jacket when you go out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感偏冷，湿度高。记得添衣，小心着凉感冒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels cold and humid. Dress warmly and watch out for colds.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感宜人。但昼夜温差大，早晚添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and pleasant. But day-night temperatures vary, add clothes in the morning and evening.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉风力较大，体感较凉。多穿一件，注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has strong winds and feels quite cool. Wear an extra layer and stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感偏冷，阴天。出门注意防寒保暖哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels cold and cloudy. Remember to dress warmly when you go out!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感微凉，湿度高。记得带伞，小心着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels slightly cool and humid. Bring an umbrella and watch out for colds.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感寒冷！风力不小，务必穿上厚外套防寒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels freezing cold! With strong winds, be sure to wear a thick coat to keep warm.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感偏凉，风力稍大。注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels cool with moderate winds. Mind the wind and stay warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感凉爽舒适，风力稍大，出门记得带外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels cool and comfortable, with moderate winds. Bring a jacket when you go out.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗炎热，体感温度高，多喝水，注意防晒。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and hot, feels very warm. Drink more water and remember sun protection.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感偏凉，风力较大。出门多穿一件，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels cool with strong winds. Wear an extra layer when you go out to avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天体感凉爽，风力不小，早晚记得加衣保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and cool with moderate winds. Remember to add clothes in the morning and evening to stay warm.
